preconditions.description: The number of points in the initial set is between 1 and 10,000, inclusive.
The given set of points contains no duplicate points.
The coordinates of each point are within the range of -1,000,000,000 to 1,000,000,000, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The size of the good superset is between n and 200,000, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: All points in the superset are integers and have absolute values not exceeding 10^9.
postconditions.description: The coordinates of all points in the superset are integers and within the range of -1,000,000,000 to 1,000,000,000, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: The superset is a good set
postconditions.description: For any two points in the superset, at least one of the three conditions is true: the points lie on the same horizontal line, the points lie on the same vertical line, or the rectangle with corners in these two points contains at least one other point in the superset.
